name: CB Industrial Product Holding Berhad
summary: Established in 1980 and based in Shah Alam, Malaysia, CB Industrial Product Holding Berhad functions as an investment holding company with a wide array of operations. The company's core business revolves around manufacturing and distributing palm oil mill machinery and associated spare parts, serving a global client base including Indonesia, Malaysia, Papua New Guinea, Central America, Africa, and Liberia.
